title: Take script v9: overnight SSH triage on jump01 (Terminal.app + Google Sheets + Google Docs in Firefox)

steps.title: Opener
steps.do: Recorder already running and minimised; the Goal doc is in front. Speak the opener with the cursor still.
say: "I will be beginning my task soon. Here is the workflow I have in mind. Um, I'm going through last night's failed SSH logins on jump01, to decide what gets blocked."

steps.title: Minimise the Goal doc
steps.do: Click the yellow minimise button of the Goal doc window [1s].
say: "Okay, so I'm moving my cursor up to the top left corner of the Goal doc, to the yellow minimise button, and" [click now] "clicking it, so only my working apps are on screen."

steps.title: Open Terminal
steps.do: Click the Terminal icon in the Dock [1s].
say: "Now I'm moving my cursor over to the Dock, which is on the left side of the screen. Terminal is the third icon from the top, and I'm" [click now] "clicking it to look at the raw log first."

steps.title: cd into Project
steps.do: Type the command, press Return [1s].
say: "Alright, Terminal's open and my cursor's sitting at the prompt."
"I'm typing a cd into my Project folder in Documents, then Return, because the log sits in that folder."

steps.title: Count failed logins
steps.do: Type the command, press Return [1s]. Point at 53.
say: "Next I'll count the failures. Typing a grep count of the Failed password lines in the jump01 auth log, and Return."
"Hmm, it printed 53. That's a lot of failed logins for one night on a jump host."
"My cursor's resting on that 53 now. It's failures only, so I don't know who sent them yet."
"Hmm, okay… and that's just one night."

steps.title: List successful logins
steps.do: Type the command, press Return [1s]. Point at the 03:52:34 and 04:20:34 lines.
say: "The bigger question is who actually got in, so I'm typing grep, Accepted in quotes, the same log file, and Return."
"Six lines. I'm moving my cursor down them. Four are ops.admin from our internal 10 range, which is fine."
"But the 03:52:34 line, svc_backup from 192.0.2.77, and the 04:20:34 one, jsmith from 198.51.100.140. I'll keep those two in mind."
"Right, so it's two outside logins I need to look at."

steps.title: Minimise Terminal
steps.do: Click the yellow minimise button of Terminal [1s].
say: "Okay, my cursor is going up to the top left of the Terminal window, to the yellow minimise button, and I'm" [click now] "clicking it, so Terminal's out of the way for Sheets."

steps.title: Open the sheet
steps.do: Click the minimised Firefox window in the Dock [1s].
say: "Now down to the bottom of the Dock on the left, where the minimised Firefox window sits. I'm" [click now] "single clicking it, and my blank sheet opens."

steps.title: Import
steps.do: Click File [1s]. Click Import [1s]. Click the Upload tab [1s]. Click Browse [1s].
say: "So I'm moving my cursor up to the menu bar at the top left, to File, the first option." [click now] "Clicking it. Then down to Import," [click now] "click."
"In the Import file window, I'll take the" [click now] "Upload tab at the top and then the" [click now] "Browse button, because I want the raw export of that log."

steps.title: Pick the excerpt file
steps.do: Click Documents in the sidebar [1s]. Double-click Project [1s]. Click auth-jump01-excerpt [1s]. Click Open [1s].
say: "The file picker's open. I'm moving my cursor to the left sidebar and" [click now] "clicking Documents, then double-clicking the" [click now] "Project folder."
"Now the auth jump01 excerpt file," [click now] "click, and the" [click now] "Open button at the bottom right."

steps.title: Import data
steps.do: Click the Import location dropdown [1s]. Click Replace current sheet [1s]. Leave Detect automatically. Click Import data [1s].
say: "Okay, my cursor's on the Import location dropdown in the middle. I'm" [click now] "opening it and picking" [click now] "Replace current sheet, so my blank sheet gets the rows."
"Separator type stays on Detect automatically. And down to the" [click now] "Import data button at the bottom left."

steps.title: Read the columns
steps.do: Sweep the header row, scroll to row 60, point at row 2. No clicks.
say: "Alright, the rows are in. I'm moving my cursor along row 1, left to right: timestamp, host, event, user, invalid user, source IP, and an empty decision column at G."
"Scrolling down now. Let me see, the last row is 60, so 59 events plus the header, same as the log."
"And back up to row 2, ops.admin from 10.20.4.11, the first line of the log too."

steps.title: Freeze and filter
steps.do: Click View [1s]. Click Freeze [1s]. Click 1 row [1s]. Click A1 [1s]. Click Data [1s]. Click Create a filter [1s].
say: "Next, my cursor's going up to the View menu," [click now] "click."
"Down to Freeze…" [click now] "click… and" [click now] "1 row, so the headers stay put."
"Now cell A1 at the top left," [click now] "click. Up to the Data menu," [click now] "click, and then" [click now] "Create a filter, so every header gets its own filter button."

steps.title: Insert the pivot
steps.do: Click A1 [1s]. Scroll down, Shift-click G60 [1s]. Click Insert [1s]. Click Pivot table [1s]. Check New sheet is set, click Create [1s]. Point at the range box.
say: "With A1 selected, I'll scroll right down to row 60, the last event."
"Holding Shift and" [click now] "clicking G60, at the bottom right of the table."
"Now I'm moving my cursor up to Insert in the menu bar," [click now] "click… and" [click now] "Pivot table. New sheet is already ticked, so I'm clicking the" [click now] "Create button."
"Okay, a new tab, Pivot table 1. The range box at the top says A1 to G60, so all 59 rows are in."

steps.title: Rows and Values
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, pivot editor on the right
steps.do: Click Add next to Rows [1s]. Click src_ip [1s]. Click Add next to Columns [1s]. Click event [1s]. Click the Show totals checkbox under event to untick it [1s].
say: "The pivot editor is on the right side. I'm moving my cursor to Add next to Rows," [click now] "clicking it, and picking" [click now] "src underscore ip."
"Then Add next to Columns," [click now] "click, and" [click now] "event. Just under it I'm" [click now] "unticking Show totals, so no total column lands in E."

steps.title: Values as COUNTA
steps.do: Click Add next to Values [1s]. Click src_ip [1s]. Click the Summarise by dropdown [1s]. Click COUNTA [1s].
say: "Now down to Add next to Values," [click now] "click… and" [click now] "src underscore ip again."
"Then the Summarise by dropdown, I'm" [click now] "opening it and picking" [click now] "COUNTA, because I'm counting attempts."

steps.title: Sort descending
steps.do: Click the Order dropdown under Rows [1s], click Descending [1s]. Click the Sort by dropdown [1s], click Failed password [1s].
say: "Now back up to Rows in the editor. I'll open the Order dropdown…" [click now] "and pick" [click now] "Descending."
"Then the Sort by dropdown," [click now] "open it, and choose" [click now] "Failed password, so the noisiest IP comes on top."

steps.title: Grand total check
steps.do: Point at D9, the Failed password Grand Total. No clicks.
say: "Let me move my cursor over to D9, the Grand Total under Failed password. It says 53, exactly what grep counted, so nothing got lost in the import."

steps.title: Read the ranking
steps.do: Move the pointer down column A, rows 3 to 8, then down column D. No clicks.
say: "Now I'm running my cursor down column A, rows 3 to 8, and reading across to column D for each count."
"I think the count only tells me who's loud, not who got in, so I'll check each IP's raw rows."
"Yeah, that ordering makes sense."

steps.title: Decision header
steps.do: Click E2 [1s]. Type the header, press Return [1s].
say: "Okay, my cursor's going to E2, the first empty column to the right of the pivot." [click now] "Clicking it, typing Decision, and Return."

steps.title: Dropdown chips
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, pivot tab, side panel
steps.do: Click E3 [1s]. Shift-click E8 [1s]. Click Insert [1s]. Click Dropdown [1s]. Type Block, click Add another item [1s], type Watch, click Add another item [1s], type Ignore. Click Done [1s].
say: "Right, my cursor is on E3, next to 203.0.113.45," [click now] "click. Holding Shift and" [click now] "clicking E8, so all six cells are selected. Then" [click now] "Insert at the top, and" [click now] "Dropdown."
"The panel opens on the right. I'll click into the first item box and type Block."
"Then" [click now] "Add another item, Watch," [click now] "Add another item, Ignore, and down to" [click now] "Done button."

steps.title: Filter the top IP
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Click the raw data tab [1s]. Click the F1 filter button [1s]. Click Clear [1s]. Click the 203.0.113.45 tick box [1s]. Click OK [1s].
say: "Okay, the top IP first. I'm moving my cursor down to the raw data tab at the bottom left and" [click now] "clicking it."
"Then up to the filter icon in F1, the source IP header. I'll" [click now] "open it," [click now] "Clear, then" [click now] "tick 203.0.113.45, and" [click now] "OK."

steps.title: Read 203.0.113.45
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Scroll slowly through the 18 rows; point at columns D, A and E. No clicks.
say: "Eighteen rows now. I'm scrolling down slowly, my cursor on column D, user. It's root eleven times and admin seven."
"Over to column A, the timestamps. They're only seconds apart, eighteen tries in about four minutes. That rhythm is a script, not a person."
"Column E, invalid user, says no, and there's no Accepted row, so this one's a Block."

steps.title: Mark Block
steps.do: Click the Pivot table 1 tab [1s]. Click the E3 chip [1s]. Click Block [1s].
say: "So I'll go back to the" [click now] "Pivot table 1 tab at the bottom, and on E3, next to 203.0.113.45, I'm" [click now] "opening the dropdown and choosing" [click now] "Block."

steps.title: Read 198.51.100.23
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Click the raw data tab [1s]. Click the F1 filter button [1s]. Click Clear [1s]. Click the 198.51.100.23 tick box [1s]. Click OK [1s]. Point at user and invalid_user.
say: "Okay, next IP. I'll go back down to the raw data tab at the bottom left and" [click now] "click it."
"Now up to the little filter icon on the source IP header," [click now] "click," [click now] "clear everything, and tick" [click now] "198.51.100.23, then" [click now] "OK."
"The users are test, ubuntu and oracle, and my cursor's on invalid user, yes on every row. These accounts don't exist on our host."
"Right, that's a username spray, fourteen tries and no success. Different tactic from the first, but both are automated."

steps.title: Mark Block
steps.do: Click the Pivot table 1 tab [1s]. Click the E4 chip [1s]. Click Block [1s].
say: "That's a Block too. Down to the" [click now] "Pivot table 1 tab. My cursor's going to E3, no, sorry, E4, next to 198.51.100.23. I'll" [click now] "open the chip and" [click now] "pick Block."

steps.title: Read 192.0.2.77
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Click the raw data tab [1s]. Click the F1 filter button [1s]. Click Clear [1s]. Click the 192.0.2.77 tick box [1s]. Click OK [1s]. Point at 03:42:17, 03:45:08 and 03:45:49.
say: "192.0.2.77 now. Back to raw data at the bottom," [click now] "click."
"I'm moving my cursor up to the F1 filter again and" [click now] "left clicking it." [click now] "Clear, then" [click now] "tick 192.0.2.77, and" [click now] "OK."
"Nine failures. Column D shows two as deploy and seven as svc_backup."
"Over to column A. They're slow, roughly forty-five seconds apart, like someone staying under a lockout limit."
"And deploy is a real account on our host, so it's not a default username list."

steps.title: Why Watch, not Block
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Keep the pointer on the 03:52:34 Accepted row. No clicks.
say: "Hmm, and I'm moving my cursor one row down. 03:52:34, Accepted password for svc_backup, same IP. Yeah, that's the worrying one."
"I'm sliding my cursor back up over the seven svc_backup fails. Yeah, seven fails then a login looks like a guessed password, so it's Watch, and svc_backup gets a reset."

steps.title: Mark Watch
steps.do: Click the Pivot table 1 tab [1s]. Click the E5 chip [1s]. Click Watch [1s].
say: "Okay, back to the" [click now] "Pivot tab. E5 is 192.0.2.77, so I'll" [click now] "open that chip and pick" [click now] "Watch."

steps.title: Read 198.51.100.140
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Click the raw data tab [1s]. Click the F1 filter button [1s]. Click Clear [1s]. Click the 198.51.100.140 tick box [1s]. Click OK [1s]. Point at 04:18:08, then 04:20:34.
say: "Right, the jsmith one. Moving my cursor back to the raw data tab," [click now] "click, and up to the source IP filter," [click now] "opening it." [click now] "Clear, tick 198.51.100.140, then" [click now] "OK."
"It's all jsmith. Pointing at the last fail, 04:18:08, then one row down, Accepted at 04:20:34."
"One real username, seven fails, then a login. That reads more like someone fumbling a password from home."

steps.title: Mark Watch
steps.do: Click the Pivot table 1 tab [1s]. Click the E6 chip [1s]. Click Watch [1s].
say: "I think I can't prove it's him, so not Ignore. Back on the" [click now] "pivot, I'm" [click now] "opening E6's chip and picking" [click now] "Watch, and we'll check with jsmith."

steps.title: Read 10.20.4.11
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Click the raw data tab [1s]. Click the F1 filter button [1s]. Click Clear [1s]. Click the 10.20.4.11 tick box [1s]. Click OK [1s]. Point at the 06:02 rows.
say: "Now our internal one. Down to raw data," [click now] "clicking it."
"Then I'm moving my cursor up to the filter on column F and" [click now] "clicking it open." [click now] "Clear, then" [click now] "tick 10.20.4.11, and" [click now] "OK."
"Down on the 06:02 rows, it's ops.admin from inside our 10 range, three password fails and then an Accepted."
"I think it's our admin on a laptop without the key. Internal, nothing for the firewall."

steps.title: Read 192.0.2.200
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Click the F1 filter button [1s]. Click Clear [1s]. Click the 192.0.2.200 tick box [1s]. Click OK [1s].
say: "And the last IP. Same filter at the top of F, I'll" [click now] "open it," [click now] "clear it, then" [click now] "tick 192.0.2.200, and" [click now] "OK."
"Just two rows, both root, both failed. Background noise, so it's under my threshold."

steps.title: Clear the filter OPTIONAL
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, raw data tab
steps.do: Click the F1 filter button [1s]. Click Select all [1s]. Click OK [1s].
say: "Let me put the filter back, so no rows look missing later. My cursor's on the F1 button," [click now] "click," [click now] "Select all, and" [click now] "OK. All 59 rows are back."

steps.title: Mark both Ignore
steps.do: Click the Pivot table 1 tab [1s]. Click the E7 chip [1s], click Ignore [1s]. Click the E8 chip [1s], click Ignore [1s].
say: "Alright, back to the Pivot table 1 tab," [click now] "click. E7 is 10.20.4.11, so I'll" [click now] "open its chip and pick" [click now] "Ignore."
"And E8 just below, 192.0.2.200, same thing," [click now] "open the chip and" [click now] "Ignore."

steps.title: Check the decisions
steps.do: Point down E3 to E8. No clicks.
say: "Now I'm moving my cursor down column E, E3 to E8. Block, Block, Watch, Watch, Ignore, Ignore. Nothing's left blank."
"And the two Watch rows are exactly the two Accepted lines Terminal showed me earlier, so the sheet and the log agree on who got in."
"Okay, that looks right."

steps.title: Decision totals
steps.do: Click D10 [1s]. Type the three labels, Return after each. Click E10 [1s]. Type the three formulas, Return after each. Point at E10 to E12.
steps.type: the lines below, Return after each
say: "Okay, a small totals block. I'm" [click now] "clicking D10, under the pivot, and typing Block, Return, Watch, Return, Ignore, Return."
"Then" [click now] "E10, and I'm typing a COUNTIF over E3 to E8 for Block, to total the decisions, and Return."
"Return drops me to E11, and the same for Watch, then E12 for Ignore."
"My cursor's on E10 to E12 now. It reads 2, 2 and 2, so all six IPs are decided."

steps.title: Copy the pivot and decisions
steps.do: Click A2 [1s]. Shift-click E8 [1s]. Press Command C.
say: "Now I'm moving my cursor up to A2, the src ip header," [click now] "click, holding Shift, and" [click now] "clicking E8, the last decision."
"And Command C to copy, which gives the note the exact IPs and counts without retyping."

steps.title: New doc
steps.do: Click the + at the right of the tab bar [1s]. Type the address, press Return [1s].
say: "I'm done in Sheets for now. Up to the tab bar at the top, the plus at the right end," [click now] "click. Typing docs dot new and pressing Return, to open a blank Google Doc."

steps.title: Title the doc
steps.do: Click Untitled document [1s]. Type the title, press Return [1s].
say: "Okay, my cursor goes to the top left, Untitled document," [click now] "click. Typing final output 2, and Return, which names the download."

steps.title: Heading CONDITIONAL
steps.do: Click into the page body [1s]. Type the heading. If Docs auto-capitalises jump01 to Jump01, press Command Z straight away and say the sorry line; otherwise skip it. Check it reads jump01, press Return.
say: "Now down into the page body," [click now] "click, and typing the heading, jump01 overnight SSH triage, 20 Oct."
"Oh, sorry, Docs capitalised it, so I'm pressing Command Z to undo that. There, jump01 is lowercase again, and Return."

steps.title: Paste the table
steps.do: Press Command V. Click Paste unlinked in the pop-up [1s].
say: "On the empty line I'm pressing Command V. A small pop-up comes up near the table, and I'm" [click now] "clicking Paste unlinked, to keep the note a fixed record."

steps.title: Check the pasted table
steps.do: Point down the pasted rows. No clicks.
say: "Let me run my cursor down the pasted table. Header row, then the six IPs with their counts and decisions. It matches the sheet, so nothing shifted."
"Yeah, the IPs came across as plain text, not links."
"Hmm, let me just check the last row… 192.0.2.200, 2, Ignore. Yes."

steps.title: Block line
steps.do: Click the empty line under the table [1s]. Type the line, press Return.
say: "So I'm moving my cursor to the empty line just under the table," [click now] "click, and typing Block 24h, 203.0.113.45 and 198.51.100.23, failure storms, no login, then Return, for the firewall owner."

steps.title: Watch line
steps.do: Type the line, press Return. Keep the pointer moving.
steps.type: the line below (one line, shown wrapped is fine)
say: "Next the Watch line. I'm typing Watch, 192.0.2.77, resetting svc_backup today, and 198.51.100.140, confirming with jsmith."
"If I block a shared office IP I might lock out real people, so I'm fixing the accounts instead."

steps.title: Close line
steps.do: Type the last line.
steps.type: `Ignore: 10.20.4.11 (internal admin typos) and 192.0.2.200 (2 tries, noise). SOC on-call`
say: "And the last line, Ignore, 10.20.4.11, internal admin typos, and 192.0.2.200, two tries, noise. Signing it SOC on-call, so they know who to come back to."

steps.title: Download .docx
steps.window: Firefox, Docs tab, then Firefox save dialog
steps.do: Click File [1s]. Click Download [1s]. Click Microsoft Word (.docx) [1s]. Click Documents [1s]. Double-click Project [1s]. Check the name reads final output 2.docx, click Save [1s].
say: "Time to save. Up to File, top left," [click now] "click."
"Down to Download," [click now] "click… and" [click now] "Microsoft Word."
"In the save window, the sidebar on the left," [click now] "Documents, then double-click" [click now] "Project. Name reads final output 2 dot docx." [click now] "Save, bottom right."

steps.title: Download .xlsx
steps.window: Firefox, Sheets tab, then Firefox save dialog
steps.do: Click the Sheets tab [1s]. Click File [1s]. Click Download [1s]. Click Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) [1s]. Click the name box [1s], Command A, type the name, read it back. Click Documents [1s], double-click Project [1s], click Save [1s].
say: "Now the sheet. I'll take my cursor up to the jump01 overnight triage tab and" [click now] "click it. Then" [click now] "File at the top left… down to" [click now] "Download… and" [click now] "Microsoft Excel."
"My cursor's on the name box," [click now] "click, and Command A to select the old name."
"Typing final output 1, so it's final output 1 dot xlsx." [click now] "Documents," [click now] "Project," [click now] "Save."

steps.title: Minimise Firefox
steps.do: Click the yellow minimise button of Firefox [1s].
say: "Both files are saved. My cursor is going to the top left corner of Firefox, the yellow minimise button, and I'm" [click now] "clicking it, so the browser's off screen for one last check."

steps.title: Back to Terminal
steps.do: Click the Terminal icon in the Dock [1s].
say: "Over to the Dock on the left again, Terminal, the third icon from the top," [click now] "clicking it. I want the per-IP counts straight from the raw log this time."

steps.title: Per-IP count
steps.do: Type the command, press Return [1s].
steps.type: grep "Failed password" auth-jump01.log | awk '{print $(NF-3)}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn   then Return
say: "I'm typing a grep for the Failed password lines, then awk for the third field from the end, that's the source IP even on invalid user lines."
"Then I pipe it through sort and uniq to count each IP, and sort again with the biggest first, and Return."

steps.title: Compare with the pivot
steps.do: Point down the output lines. No clicks.
say: "Okay, my cursor's on the first output line. 18 for 203.0.113.45, then 14 for 198.51.100.23, then 9, 7, 3 and 2."
"Moving down the lines, that's the Sheets pivot exactly, row for row. Two tools, same answer, which means the import was clean."

steps.title: One more Accepted check STRETCH
steps.do: Type the command, press Return [1s]. Point at the single svc_backup line at 03:52:34. No clicks. Skip this step if you are running long.
say: "Okay, one more quick check, if I have time. I'm typing grep, Accepted, then pipe grep 192.0.2.77, and Return…"
"Just the one svc_backup line at 03:52:34, so nothing else got in from that IP."

steps.title: Back to the pivot
steps.window: Terminal (left half, neutral $ prompt), then Firefox
steps.do: Click the yellow minimise button of Terminal [1s]. Click the minimised Firefox window in the Dock [1s]. Click the Pivot table 1 tab [1s].
say: "Alright, up to the yellow minimise button at the top left of Terminal," [click now] "click, since I'm done in the shell."
"Then" [click now] "Firefox from the bottom of the Dock, for the final check on the pivot, and the" [click now] "Pivot table 1 tab."

steps.title: Sanity check
steps.do: Talk and point: D9, then rows 3 to 8, then E5 and E6, then rows 7 and 8, then E10 to E12. No clicks.
say: "So, how did I check it? I'm moving my cursor to D9, the grand total. The pivot says 53, and the grep count in Terminal said 53 too."
"Now down rows 3 to 8 in column D. 18, 14, 9, 7, 3 and 2, same as the pipeline, nothing dropped or doubled."
"And now I'll take my cursor to rows 3 and 4, the two blocks. Neither had an Accepted row, so a firewall rule there costs us nothing."
"Twenty-four hours is on purpose. These addresses change hands, so a permanent block mostly hits whoever gets them next."
"The tricky one was 192.0.2.77, E5. Nine fails, two as deploy, seven as svc_backup, then svc_backup in at 03:52:34."
"Moving down to E6, jsmith's address, 198.51.100.140. Both Watch rows are the two outside logins grep Accepted showed me, so they get an account action, not a block."
"Rows 7 and 8: 10.20.4.11 is our admin mistyping, and 192.0.2.200 is two tries of noise. Blocking those just bloats the list."
"Honestly, if I had more time, I'd check jsmith's login against the VPN logs and see what svc_backup touched after 03:52:34."
"Last, my cursor's on E10 to E12, 2, 2 and 2. The note says exactly what to change, and both files are in the Project folder."

steps.title: Close
steps.do: Say the close line, then click the recorder in the Dock [1s] and click Stop silently [1s].
say: "Everything matches and both files are done. And that completes this task."
